title: The 20% Micron Crash: What You Need To Know Now
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.theme: Healthy pullback in a bull market
macro_themes.view: Nasdaq was overbought at all-time highs; the selloff is a slight, healthy pullback in a 2026 bull market and a dip-buying opportunity.
Excess leverage (e.g. KOSPI down 35% from highs) amplifies selloffs; beginners should size small and avoid leverage.

calls.reason: Down ~20% in a week from 1,113 to ~887 after-hours; strong fundamentals (12.2 P/E, ~43% fair-value upside, huge revenue/net income); sees the dip as a buying opportunity but small size, no leverage, could fall further first.
calls.quote: There's no question that I see this as an opportunity to buy the dip.

calls.reason: Pullback from overbought all-time highs is healthy within a bull market; long side favored.
calls.quote: You can make more money going long than going short, especially in a bull market. And that is the current sentiment.

notes: Mostly a position-sizing lesson. MU target 1100 inferred from 'if it returns back to 1,100' / 'recover ... to previous highs 20%'; treat as soft. Mentions PPI 'tomorrow' and earnings week ahead; date kept from listing.
